map.不代表好坏，只是描述差异。例如高神经质意味着情绪更易波动，高宜人性意味着更友善合: It does not mean better or worse, only that traits differ. For instance high neuroticism means emotions fluctuate more easily and high agreeableness means more friendly and cooperative; neither is better, and each should be read in context.
map.五大维度：开放性 / 责任心 / 外倾性 / 宜人性 / 神经质: Five dimensions: openness / conscientiousness / extraversion / agreeableness / neuroticism
map.分数高或低代表好坏吗？: Do high or low scores mean good or bad?
map.可与家人朋友分享讨论差异: You can share the differences with family or friends and discuss them
map.团队建设：理解成员差异、减少摩擦: Team building: understand member differences and reduce friction
map.基于主流人格心理学的大五因素模型（Big Five / OCEAN），通过一系列: Based on the Big Five model (Big Five / OCEAN) of mainstream personality psychology, a series of statements about behaviour and preference rates how high or low you are on openness, conscientiousness, extraversion, agreeableness and neuroticism, helping you understand relatively stable personality traits. Results are for self-understanding only.
map.多题项李克特自评，按真实倾向打分: Multi-item Likert self-rating, scored by your real tendency
map.大五人格和 MBTI 有什么区别？: What is the difference between the Big Five and MBTI?
map.大五人格测试（OCEAN）- 在线工具: Big Five personality test (OCEAN) - online tool
map.大五是维度模型，每个特质用连续高分到低分表示，更贴近心理学实证研究；MBTI 是: The Big Five is a dimensional model where each trait runs on a continuous high-to-low scale, closer to empirical psychological research; MBTI is a typological model placing people into 16 either-or bins, so its retest stability is relatively lower.
map.完成后查看五个维度的得分剖面: When finished, view the score profile across the five dimensions
map.对照每个维度的解释理解高低含义: Use the per-dimension explanation to understand what high and low mean
map.成年后大五特质相对稳定，但会随人生阶段、环境与刻意练习缓慢变化，分数更多反映当前: In adulthood the Big Five traits are relatively stable but shift slowly with life stage, environment and deliberate practice, so the scores reflect currently stable tendencies rather than fixed labels.
map.按真实感受而非\"应该怎样\"作答，结果才更有意义: Answer from how you actually feel rather than how you think you should, and the result becomes meaningful
map.按第一直觉对每句陈述打分，不要过度思考: Score each statement on first instinct without overthinking
map.特质相对稳定但会缓慢变化，不必当成固定标签: Traits are relatively stable but change slowly, so do not treat them as fixed labels
map.用于增进理解，而非评判自己或他人: For better understanding, not for judging yourself or others
map.结合具体事例看看是否符合自己: Check against concrete examples to see whether it fits you
map.结果可保存与复测对比: Results can be saved and compared on retest
map.给出偏高的维度画像与解读: Gives the profile of the higher dimensions with an interpretation
map.维度是连续谱，没有\"标准答案\"，分数只代表相对高低: Dimensions are continuous spectra with no standard answer, and scores only show relative level
map.职业规划：看岗位与特质的匹配度: Career planning: see how well a role matches your traits
map.自动算出各维度相对高低: Automatically compute the relative level of each dimension
map.自我探索：理解自己的行为与交往模式: Self-exploration: understand your own behaviour and interaction patterns
